caseNameFull: Flanagan et ux. v. Arnaiz Muhammad v. Federal Republic of Nigeria

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir.; and C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until November 3, 1998, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
